cohort: The study included 294 neonates (both in-patients and out-patients) who were either born at JLNMCH or attended the hospital for treatment in Bhagalpur, Bihar, India, over a 10-month period.
finding: Neonatal jaundice (51.01%), sepsis (17.00%), low birth weight, preterm birth, TTN, RDS, and MAS were identified as the most common morbidities among neonates, with an overall mortality rate of 8.33%.
birth_weight: Average birth weight was 3.2 kg, with 72.10% of neonates weighing 3-4 kg.
gest_age: 90.10% of babies were born at term, while 9.18% were preterm.
